name: Merge PDF
tagline: Combine PDFs and choose the exact page order
description: Combine PDF documents into one file and rearrange the merge queue before exporting. Move files up or down, remove a selected file from the queue, then merge reports, forms or document sections in the order you choose. Processing uses pdf-lib in your browser; large PDFs may require substantial device memory.
seoTitle: Merge PDF Files Online — Reorder and Combine PDFs for Free | Nexauren
seoDescription: Merge PDF files online, reorder documents before combining them and remove unwanted files from the queue. Free in-browser PDF merger.
features: Merge multiple PDFs into one document
Move files up and down before merging
steps: Select two or more PDF files.
Use the arrows to set their final order or remove a file from the queue.
Merge the ordered documents.
Download and review the combined PDF.

name: Extract PDF Pages
tagline: Extract wanted pages or remove unwanted pages
description: Enter PDF page numbers and ranges such as 1, 3-5, 8, then choose whether to extract only those pages into a new document or remove those pages while keeping the rest. Page numbering starts at 1, ranges are validated before export, and the source file is left unchanged.
seoTitle: Extract or Remove PDF Pages Online — Free PDF Page Tool | Nexauren
seoDescription: Extract selected pages from a PDF or remove unwanted pages. Use page numbers and ranges in a free browser-based PDF tool.
features: Extract selected pages into a new PDF
Remove selected pages and keep the rest
steps: Choose a PDF file.
Enter pages or ranges, for example 1, 3-5, 8.
Choose Extract pages or Remove pages.
Export the new PDF and check the result.

name: Rotate PDF Pages
description: Correct sideways pages in a PDF by rotating all pages or selected page numbers and ranges. The page selection is validated before export, and the original PDF remains untouched.
seoTitle: Rotate PDF Pages Online — Fix Page Orientation | Nexauren
seoDescription: Rotate PDF pages online by 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Choose page ranges and download a corrected PDF in your browser.
steps: Choose a PDF file.
Choose a rotation angle.
Enter page ranges or leave blank to rotate every page.
Apply the rotation and download the result.

name: Images to PDF
tagline: Combine photos into one PDF document
description: Turn one or more supported pictures into a single PDF document. Each image is fitted to a clean page while preserving its proportions. Useful for scanned papers, receipts and photo-based handouts.
seoTitle: Images to PDF Online — Convert Photos to PDF | Nexauren
seoDescription: Convert JPG, PNG and browser-supported images into a PDF document. Combine multiple pictures into one file for free.
steps: Choose one or more images.
Select A4 or Letter page size.
Create the PDF and check the number of pages.
Download the document.

name: PDF Inspector
tagline: Inspect page count and document metadata
description: Review basic information stored inside a PDF, including page count, title, author, creator, producer and file size. This tool inspects document properties; it does not certify a PDF's safety or validate digital signatures.
seoTitle: PDF Inspector Online — Check PDF Pages & Metadata | Nexauren
seoDescription: Inspect a PDF online to view page count, title, author, creator and file size. A free browser-based PDF information tool.
steps: Select a PDF file.
Inspect its document information.
Review available metadata and page count.
Close the page when finished; nothing is stored in an account.
